primary_source.read_method: Existing cached pypdf6.21.2 offline; no PDF copied or dependency installed into repository

provisions.11.3.6.1: Equation11.3-1 multiplies reference lateral design values for the listed connector types or dowel fasteners D<=1inch in a row. The expressly stated Cg1 exception here is dowel D<1/4inch. No general perpendicular-to-grain Cg1 exception is stated.
provisions.11.3.6.2b: A dowel row requires at least two same-diameter dowel fasteners in single or multiple shear aligned with the load direction.
provisions.11.3.6.2_staggering: Merge adjacent staggered rows when their separation is less than one quarter of the closest longitudinal offset between their fasteners; apply pairwise for even row count and conservatively for odd row count.
provisions.11.3.6.3: Use gross member cross sections. For a perpendicular-to-grain-loaded member, equivalent area is member thickness times overall fastener-group width. If only one row is used, group width is the minimum parallel-to-grain fastener spacing.
provisions.11.3.6C: Steel side-plate table is PDFpage8/printed76; its stated tabulation conservatism covers D<1inch or spacing<4inch. Exact member EA and row/application conditions remain necessary.

v10_grid_application.interpretation: For a compatible principal load direction, a2x2 rectangular grid can have two2-fastener load-aligned rows rather than one4-fastener row. Actual row ownership, load direction, equivalent areas and the staggering rule must be established. Independent bolt forces or an EA lower-bound computation alone do not establish complete connection applicability.
